title: Integrated Shield Plan Coverage for Inpatient Hospice Services
what_it_is: Integrated Shield Plan Coverage for Inpatient Hospice Services

sections.label: Hospice care coverage and affordability
sections.summary: Hospice care is covered under some riders, not required in IPs, and is affordable through subsidies, charity and MediSave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hospice care is covered under some riders, such as Great Eastern's Total Health Riders or AXA's Home Care Riders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) does not require IPs to cover hospice care, as an expansion of IP benefits will, inevitably, result in higher premiums for all policyholders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Based on data collected by MOH, hospice care is affordable through a combination of Government subsidies, charity dollars and MediSave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: About eight out of 10 inpatient hospice bills did not require out-of-pocket cash payment while about nine in 10 home palliative care patients did not have to make out-of-pocket cash payments for their care.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Needy patients who require further assistance can receive financial support through MediFund.

sections.label: Hospice care subsidy percentile
sections.summary: Government subsidies for inpatient and home hospice care are extended up to the 67th percentile.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Today, Government subsidies for hospice care, both inpatient hospice care as well as home hospice care, are extended up to the 67th percentile.

sections.label: Reviewing MediShield Life intent
sections.summary: MediShield Life, started 1 November last year, must be regularly reviewed and focused on covering large hospital bills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The important point is that this is something which we will have to regularly review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We just started MediShield Life from 1 November last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: It is important for us to focus the scheme on the original intent in which it was set up to do, which is to cover large hospital bills.
